question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3
solution:
The correct answer is '**compare**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The context indicates that the professor likened or equated his audience to a herd of cows, which involves making a comparison.
 
• "Compare" is the most appropriate word as it describes the act of likening one thing to another.
